notes.title: The Silent Swan - 1.3 update patch notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/b2c8ef26a9303ec6928e1d44ca50247a7edaae02.png

The latest The Silent Swan update is now available!

This update fixes the following minor bugs:


An optional cursor has been added in the center of the screen for people with vision problems or motion sickness.
Fix some hints were not updating when completed.
Fix jump height achievement could not be get sometimes.
Increase linear dialogue time between entries.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1898880/The_Silent_Swan/

notes.title: The Silent Swan - 1.2 update patch notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/b2c8ef26a9303ec6928e1d44ca50247a7edaae02.png

The latest The Silent Swan update is now available!

This update mainly fixes the recurrent low texture quality throughout the game alongside the following minor bug fixes:


 “The Belltower” achievement can now be obtained, requiring to ring the bell atop the belltower.
 “Lost in the Woods” achievement has been fixed, requiring to reach the Verdurant Lair (Shaman’s lair).
 “The Last Road” achievement has been fixed, requiring to walk through the gates of the Unseen Complex.
 “The Bells of Kavrazyma” achievement has been fixed, requiring to interact with 10 different bells.
 Notebook is now disabled during the opening sequence.
Corrected low quality textures.
City props added.
Corrected sounds.
Programming changes of some achievements, now they are easier to get.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1898880/The_Silent_Swan/

notes.title: The Silent Update: 0.8.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/c4b5736647b9cc95675bcb5772a0132f0725d51e.png

We continue to work hard to improve the game.

As such, here is the next batch of changes and corrections. This is the changelog:

Fixed

Music reset its volume after looping
Start music volume is too low
Some minor fixes


Improved

Optimized some props in the main road and Hanan
Upgraded some Hanan wires for better comprehension


Changed

Moved hanan's electric cabin to avoid being overlooked


That is all for now, we keep working, see you Beyond the Walls!

notes.title: The Silent Update: 0.8.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/1a1c1fbf5e9be1bb901fcd724b9b3ebcbecc7755.png

We are ecstatic about the incredible amount of feedback we have been receiving lately, and we would like to thank you all for it.

As promised, we continue to work hard to improve the game.

As such, here is the first batch of changes and corrections. This is the changelog:

Fixed

Quicycles cannot be interacted with
Tree and vegetation popping
Hanan elevator has no sound
In road parkour it is not possible to go back up easily due to collision errors
Neuron Box door cannot be opened (partial fix, still researching for bugs)
Some postprocessing not working as intended
Transition fading with Selene sometimes do not trigger when it should
Some minor fixes


Improved

Player now jumps slightly higher


Changed

Gamepad control for jump rebinded from A (XBOX) / X (PS) to B (XBOX) / O (PS)


That is all for now, we keep working, see you Beyond the Walls!
